quests.instruction: FLICK THE COIN TO VERIFY THE FACT
quests.passage: [Abyss Vent 111-1] Water near hydrothermal vents can reach temperatures of 350 degrees Celsius, which is high enough to melt lead. However, the extreme hydrostatic pressure at the bottom of the ocean prevents the water from boiling.

quests.passage: [Coral Zone 111-2] Although coral reefs cover less than 0.1% of the world's ocean surface, they host and nurture over 25% of all marine life, earning them the nickname 'rainforests of the sea'.
